title: Browser product optimization follow-up measurements
scope: Read-only product review with isolated experiments on current-source functions and browser API paths. These rows do not estimate latency in deployed products.

native_webp_worker.runtime: Linux, headless Playwright Chromium 159.0.8154.6; isolated localhost context; one serial Worker; quality 0.60
native_webp_worker.input: Eight different synthetic opaque BT.709 limited-range I420 VideoFrame objects. Coded 720 × 736, visible 720 × 720. Generated up front, cloned for each run. No decode, scaling or rotation.
native_webp_worker.arm_a: Draw to a willReadFrequently Canvas, getImageData, force the alpha channel opaque, transfer the ArrayBuffer to the Worker, putImageData, encode to WebP and transfer the output bytes back.
native_webp_worker.arm_b: Transfer the VideoFrame to the same Worker, draw it directly, close it, encode and transfer the output bytes back.
native_webp_worker.method: One untimed warm-up per arm. Ten alternating A/B and B/A pairs. Each reported value covers eight sequential encodes from host dispatch to return of compressed frame bytes. Check byte identity after timing.
native_webp_worker.limits: One synthetic geometry and one browser. No product UI, demux, decode, mux, dynamic pressure, multiple workers, smart skip, cold loading, Windows, process or GPU peak measurement.

discarded_alpha.input: 720 × 720 synthetic packed pixel input. Frozen source convertImageData and convertRGBAToRGB. Reused destination stub common to both arms. No native Canvas I/O in the timed interval.
discarded_alpha.method: Branch early only for packed RGB, keeping opaque normalization for RGBA. Six warm-up pairs, then twelve alternating pairs, 24 calls per arm in each pair. Units below are milliseconds per call.
discarded_alpha.parity: Four image sizes, two byte offsets, two output layouts, varying alpha. All 16 paired outputs matched; RGBA stayed opaque.

gallery_blob_zip.input: Eight generated immutable binary Blobs of lengths 2*1024*1024+i*127 bytes, i from 0 through 7. Byte j is (i*31+j*17+(j>>13)) mod 256.
gallery_blob_zip.method: Original stored ZIP writer materialized every source Blob as an ArrayBuffer. Experimental writer updated CRC from Blob slices of up to 1 MiB and retained the original Blob as each member body. Entries were committed serially, with a common local yield adapter. Compared complete bytes and read all members with Python zipfile.
gallery_blob_zip.limits: Logical references in writer parts only. Does not measure browser heap, peak process memory, cache eviction, concurrency, end-to-end latency or resource admission.

overlay_author.method: Pinned drawAuthorSection with counting Canvas substitute, three width conditions, each with and without existing author bounds, 120 frames per case.
overlay_author.checks: Drawn names, coordinates, returned Y, font and baseline matched. Browser latency not timed.
